input.quote: 3.19 Exclusivity Commitment of SFJ. During the applicable Exclusive Period, SFJ shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, either by itself or through a Third Party, conduct human clinical trials of, or sell, offer for sale or have sold:
input.rationale: The only exclusivity construct in the Agreement runs against the counterparty: Section 3.19 (with the "Exclusive Period" definition at 1.1.68) bars SFJ and its Affiliates from developing or selling Competing Products, which benefits PB and is therefore not a deviation. No provision obliges PB to source exclusively from SFJ or to refrain from procuring goods or services from third parties: Sections 2.4.1–2.4.3 let each Party (including PB) delegate to Affiliates, any CRO on Exhibit B or JDC-approved, and contract with any Approved Vendor, and PB is itself the GMP Manufacturer under Section 3.14.1.1, directly or through an Approved CRO. Article 7's covenants (including the Section 7.5.5 Licensing Transaction consent gate, which is limited by the Excluded Licensing Transaction carve-out and an expedited arbitration test) are financing-style negative covenants over IP and royalty streams, not sole-supplier or exclusive-dealing obligations, so they fall outside this rule. This meets the preferred position — no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the Customer.
